home.title: Payslip digitization
home.subtitle: Photograph or upload your payslips, check the extracted data and export it.

merge.pickLegend: Which payslip holds the other pages of this one?
merge.title: Merge payslips
merge.consequence: The two payslips are replaced by one. It is read again from the combined document, so edits, unsaved changes and confirmation on both are discarded.
merge.swapped: Order swapped. Payslip {{index}} is now first.
merge.suggestion: Payslips {{a}} and {{b}} look like pages of one payslip.

errors.merge_not_allowed: These payslips can no longer be merged. One of them may already be merged, deleted or being read again.
errors.merge_source_unreadable: One of the documents could not be read, so they cannot be combined.
errors.pdf_too_many_pages: Together these documents have more than 10 pages. A payslip can have at most 10.
errors.file_too_large: Together these documents are larger than 10 MB, so they cannot be combined.
errors.network: The merge could not be started. Check your connection and try again.
